Package com.bilt.pos.media.service

package com.bilt.pos.media.service
The contract between the retail-media widget and the ad decision platform, plus an in-memory fake for tests and the emulator.

AdDecisionService is the whole surface the widget needs: it registers a shopper session described by an AdSessionSnapshot, asks for a decision per placement within a deadline, validates the shopper's taps, reports interactions, and subscribes to events the platform originates. The snapshot types here are deliberately independent of the checkout session API (CheckoutSession, SessionBasket, IdentifyResult); the widget projects a session into a snapshot so the service can evolve on its own.

InMemoryAdDecisionService is the fake: scripted renderings per placement, artificial latency, failure injection, recorded snapshots and reports, and test-injected events. Everything downstream can be built and demoed against it until the platform-backed implementation lands.
